checkpoints.world_note: No world edit. The three seals are BP_NPC_Seal_NecromanticFocus actors that store only bCanBeDamaged in both worlds; breaking is driven entirely by the character's <X>SealBroken bools. BP_Seal_Switchable is NOT a seal: it is the single Imaru lair door (participant ImaruLairTeleportDoor, SwitchPosition 0 in both worlds) and is only touched at Beat 5, so no switch reset is needed. Standing stones, cleansing pools and Death's-temple teleporter are stateless too. The Emberwood seal sits behind the Emberwood village barrier, which IS world switch state: in World A all four god shrines (Armadyl, Guthix_2, Zamorak, Saradomin_MissingPiece) are SwitchPosition 1, so the barrier stays open; in World B the FH cells were never saved, so the shrines are at defaults and the puzzle is replayed in game (flows not gated on WH beat; the Saradomin piece dispenser is at 0).
